method: Typed into a page in a personal Cosense project, with the caret on another line so every line rendered idle. Screenshots of the rendered screen were examined. No developer tools, network traffic, or scripts were inspected. `tagName` is the string shown as the tag, read from the screen; the target page name was not observed. An absent `facts` key was not observable from the screen; `null` means observed and absent. The filler text placed around syntax during observation was replaced with ASCII; the syntax under observation remains as entered.
location: A scratch page in a personal Cosense project, deleted after the observation.
